description: This file defines structures, function prototypes, and constants for handling reftable tables, including opening, reference counting, iterating, and accessing table metadata in a version control system context.

methods.name: reftable_table_new
methods.description: Opens a reftable for reading, initializes the table structure, and manages the block source.

methods.name: reftable_table_incref
methods.description: Increments the reference count of a reftable to manage its lifetime.

methods.name: reftable_table_decref
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and deletes the table when count reaches zero.

methods.name: reftable_table_init_ref_iterator
methods.description: Initializes an iterator for reading references from the table.

methods.name: reftable_table_init_log_iterator
methods.description: Initializes an iterator for reading logs from the table.

methods.name: reftable_table_hash_id
methods.description: Returns the hash ID used in the table.

methods.name: reftable_table_refs_for
methods.description: Provides an iterator for references pointing to a specific object ID.

methods.name: reftable_table_max_update_index
methods.description: Returns the maximum update index for the table.

methods.name: reftable_table_min_update_index
methods.description: Returns the minimum update index for the table.

methods.name: reftable_table_iterator_init
methods.description: Initializes an iterator to traverse the blocks in a table.

methods.name: reftable_table_iterator_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a table iterator.

methods.name: reftable_table_iterator_next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next block in the table.
